calls.summary: The team is nearing completion of partner sign-offs to launch their program effectively, with plans to target additional partners afterward. The focus is on creating streamlined content to help users easily navigate podcast-related material. Additionally, a clean-up of YouTube content is underway using dashboard data to improve user experience and content discoverability. An AI-driven nurture strategy, led by James Shannon, emphasizes personalized outreach through LinkedIn, with plans for automated pipelines and enriched data to refine targeting. Development of a content library is underway, sorting various content types for personalized nurture aligned with prospect needs. The team discussed leveraging product usage signals for deeper engagement, and clear coordination efforts are in place for ongoing collaboration.
calls.keywords: AI automation, personalized outreach, content library, nurture strategy, MCP server, partner sign-off

calls.summary:
# Leap Strategies Projects Review
Date: 2026-08-25 | Duration: 32.20000076293945m

## Summary
During the meeting, the team addressed the status of partner creative content, confirming three completed reviews but awaiting final approvals from contacts. YouTube strategy included automating playlist organization to enhance discoverability while prioritizing newer content, with decisions to remove low-view duplicates for better viewer experience. Upcoming featured video plans were outlined, focusing on a five-minute demo recording to boost engagement. Customer segmentation was defined around companies with specific employee and user thresholds, with plans to personalize content based on user signals. Additionally, content gaps were identified, particularly a need for comparison guides for product editions, along with expanding case studies. Operational needs like access to necessary tools were also discussed.

## Keywords
YouTube playlists, Conversionista Creatives, Rio Clay nurture, content segmentation, MCP server video, customer case studies

## Action Items

**Karen Henke**
Send the signed weekly 20-hour contract to Jennifer to progress the engagement (01:38)
Identify and reach out to contacts for pending Conversionista Creatives and staged projects once contact info is clarified with Ashley (02:41)
Remove duplicate videos with fewer views and unlist old or awkward visual editor videos as discussed (12:42)
Build and organize YouTube playlists according to the discussed structure and priorities, including best of experimentation and customer playlists (18:26)
Request access to Rio Clay and HubSpot to proceed with the nurture campaign work (21:11)
Compile a content "menu" listing available assets and wishlist items, including addition comparisons for prospects (21:38)
Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to gather feedback on current content effectiveness and client engagement (29:58)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Provide Karen with access to or inform about contact points for Conversionista Creatives and staged projects (02:31)
Continue sending Conversionista Creative content to contacts including Spiro who is currently on vacation (03:59)
Work on the upcoming MCP server video to maintain trending content momentum (20:30)
Share the Slack skill "slash Rio account briefing" with Karen for self-service customer data access (28:46)
Collaborate with Alyssa on creating addition compare-and-contrast content (30:50)
